#Introduction
This section of code was used to select uncorrelated climate variables from the 1961-1990 historical normals downloaded from ClimateNA.

#choosing climate variables
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
setwd("~/GitHub/Ash/FRANIG_Seed")

#read in climate data
df <- read_csv("~/GitHub/Ash/FRANIG_Seed/FRANIG_CG_SeedMoprh_MasterLocations_Normal_1961_1990Y.csv")
df$State <- substr(df$id1,8,9)

climate <- df[,7:31] #25 annual variables from climateNA
cor_matrix<-cor(climate, method = "pearson")
cor_matrix2<-as.data.frame(cor_matrix)
cor_matrix2$mean_cor<-rowMeans(abs(cor_matrix2), na.rm = TRUE)

#choose the variable with the highest mean correlation to keep, in this case DD5
#remove variables with higher than 0.75 correlation with DD5
#remove MAR because it's wacky

vars <- c("DD5", "MAT", "MCMT", "TD", "MAP", "MSP",  "SHM", "DD_0", "DD_18", 
          "eFFP","EMT", "PAS", "CMD", "RH", "CMI")

clim2<-climate[,vars]
cor2<-cor(clim2, method = "spearman")
cor2<-as.data.frame(cor2)
cor2$mean_cor<-rowMeans(abs(cor2), na.rm = TRUE)

#do it again, this time keeping MAT

vars <- c("DD5", "MAT","MAP","TD", "MSP",  "SHM","EMT", "PAS", "CMD", "CMI","RH")

clim3<-climate[,vars]
cor3<-cor(clim3, method = "spearman")
cor3<-as.data.frame(cor3)
cor3$mean_cor<-rowMeans(abs(cor3), na.rm = TRUE)

#once more, keeping MAP as the highest and keeping TD over EMT because it's more informative

vars <-c("DD5", "MAT","MAP", "MSP", "TD", "SHM", "CMD", "RH")

clim4<-climate[,vars]
cor4<-cor(clim4, method = "spearman")
cor4<-as.data.frame(cor4)
cor4$mean_cor<-rowMeans(abs(cor4), na.rm = TRUE)

#remove SHM because it's correlated with CMD and MSP

final_vars <-c("DD5", "MAT","MAP", "MSP", "TD", "CMD", "RH")

library(corrplot)
corrplot(cor_matrix, method = "color", type = "lower", col = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(200),addCoef.col = "black", tl.cex = 0.8,tl.col = "black", number.cex = 0.4)

#this set of 7 climate variables should be <0.75

#subset the dataframe to only the selected variables for the PCA
PCA_in <- df[,final_vars]

#perform PCA
FRANIG.PCA.scaled <- prcomp(PCA_in, center = T, scale = T)

library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggbiplot)
library(ggplot2)

#colors for State level
my_colors <- c("#FF7F00", "#6A3D9A" , "#A6CEE3","#33A02C" , "#1F78B4" ,"#E31A1C" , "#FB9A99" ,"#b5b5b5","#CAB2D6","#B2DF8A", "#ecd72b" ,"#B15928" , "#FDBF6F" , "#a13584")

#colors for experiment delineation
experiment <- c("#BED2FF", "#004DA8")

#manuscript plot
p <- ggbiplot(FRANIG.PCA.scaled,var.scale = 1, groups = df$Experiment) + scale_fill_manual( values = experiment) + theme(panel.background = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_line("grey")) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, col = "black") + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, col = "black") + geom_point(aes(color=df$Experiment ,fill =df$Experiment), size = 5, shape = 21, color = "black", alpha = 0.5) + scale_y_continuous(trans = "reverse")
p
seg <- which(sapply(p$layers, function(x) class(x$geom)[1] == 'GeomSegment'))
txt <- which(sapply(p$layers, function(x) class(x$geom)[1] == 'GeomText'))
p$layers[[seg]]$aes_params$colour <- 'black'
p$layers[[seg]]$aes_params$size <- 1
p$layers[[txt]] <- geom_label(aes(x = xvar, y = yvar, label = varname, angle = angle, hjust = hjust), label.size = NA,data = p$layers[[txt]]$data, fill = '#dddddd80')
p$layers <- c(p$layers[-c(seg, txt)], p$layers[c(seg, txt)])
p$layers <- p$layers[-1]
p

PCs <- data.frame("PC1" = FRANIG.PCA.scaled$x[,1], "PC2" = FRANIG.PCA.scaled$x[,2], "Family" = df$id1)

write.csv(FRANIG.PCA.scaled$rotation, file = "FRANIG_SeedMorph_PCLoadings_Climate.csv")

```
